items.text: Ladd McConkey now has been ruled out with a concussion.
items.why: Head injury evaluation during game vs Chiefs; ruled out.
items.implication: Chargers lose top WR mid-game; enters concussion protocol.
items.opportunity: Immediate target bump to Quentin Johnston and other LAC WRs for remainder.

items.text: Bills WR DJ Moore is inactive; Josh Palmer is active.
items.why: Shoulder or related; late inactive confirmation.
items.implication: Bills WR targets shift; Palmer elevated role opposite primary options.
items.opportunity: Increased routes/targets for Josh Palmer and remaining Bills WRs.

items.text: Quinshon Judkins inactive. Browns only have Jaleel McLaughlin (5'7/187) and Audric Estime (signed off Vikings practice squad Tuesday).
items.why: Ankle injury; tested pregame but did not like how it felt.
items.implication: Browns RB depth extremely thin; McLaughlin and Estime only options for carries.
items.opportunity: Full backfield opportunity to McLaughlin/Estime; elevated handcuff value.

items.text: Colts TE Tyler Warren is inactive today.
items.why: Groin injury that appeared on Friday report.
items.implication: Colts TE targets redistribute to Mo Alie-Cox, Will Mallory and WRs like Josh Downs.
items.opportunity: Streamer TE spot opens; more short-area/red-zone work for backups and Downs.

items.text: Actives today include: Caleb Williams, Rico Dowdle, Chris Olave, Alvin Kamara, Kenyon Sadiq, Ja’Kobi Lane. Inactives: Quinshon Judkins, Tyler Warren.
items.why: Cleared after Q tags (Olave illness, Kamara back, Williams hamstring return).
items.implication: Full expected roles for Saints pass-catchers and Bears QB start.
items.opportunity: Normal snap/target/carry shares locked in; reverse any fade beneficiaries.

items.text: Tyler Warren inactive. Tyjae Spears active.
items.why: Full practice Friday; cleared despite Q tag.
items.implication: Spears available as Titans RB2/receiving back behind Pollard vs Colts.
items.opportunity: PPR flex/handcuff snaps and targets as change-of-pace.

items.text: Both [TreVeyon Henderson and Will Campbell] officially active. With AJ Brown returning, NE is close to full health.
items.why: Ankle issues cleared; AJ Brown roster activated prior day.
items.implication: Patriots near full strength offensively vs Jets.
items.opportunity: Henderson RB role + AJ Brown WR targets/routes available as projected.

items.text: Whoa! [Warren] Popped up on injury report but still surprising. Juwan Johnson, Friermuth and Higbee among my fave streamer TE's ...
items.why: Warren surprise inactive opens TE streamer lane.
items.implication: Pivot to Juwan Johnson, Pat Freiermuth, Tyler Higbee as preferred options.
items.opportunity: Immediate TE fill-in value for those streamers.

items.text: If I have to start a NYG RB I'm still starting Cam as I still think his explosiveness gives him best chance at a score. Esp against NO. But it's certainly a riskier start now. He's more of a flex than RB 2. And this was why Cam was on pre-season 'hate' list. I have Cam Skattebo at RB 28, Najee Harris at RB 33.
items.why: Explosiveness vs Saints defense outweighs rotation risk/fumbles for TD upside; prefers over Najee in split.
items.implication: Still startable but downgraded confidence; flex over RB2.
items.opportunity: Monitor actual snap split; Najee for safer TD shot in some matchups.
items.conflict: Conflicts with pure efficiency/usage data showing poor YOE and expected larger Najee role.

items.text: Cam Skattebo currently 37th out of 43 qualifying RBs in rush yards over expectation. He's also fumbled four times (lost one).
items.why: Poor YOE efficiency + 4 fumbles; sources indicate rotation change with Najee Harris larger share while Skattebo still mixed in. All 4 RBs active.
items.implication: Reduced ceiling/safer floor risk; more committee.
items.opportunity: Fewer early-down/goal-line snaps possible; Najee steals work.
items.conflict: Berry still prefers starting Skattebo for explosiveness vs NO but ranks RB28 riskier flex.

items.text: Summary of weekend #FantasyFootball reports: GAME-TIME DECISION * Quinshon Judkins * Tyler Warren * Mike Evans, Christian Kirk EXPECTED TO PLAY * Caleb Williams * Chris Olave, Alvin Kamara * AJ Brown, TreVeyon Henderson * DK Metcalf * Pat Freiermuth * Kenyon Sadiq NOT EXPECTED TO PLAY * Deebo Samuel * Jacory Croskey-Merritt * Sean Tucker ACTIVATED * Jaydon Blue
items.why: Compiled weekend reports for Sunday tracking.
items.implication: Core status board for last-minute decisions; many resolved later to active/out.
items.opportunity: Track GTD for Evans/Kirk; expected lock in roles for listed actives.

items.text: GAME-TIME DECISION * Mike Evans, Christian Kirk
items.implication: Monitor pregame/warmups closely for final call.
items.opportunity: If OUT, major bump to remaining TB WRs/TEs; if IN, normal WR1 role.

items.text: #Saints RB Alvin Kamara (back) and WR Chris Olave (illness) are both listed as questionable and both expected to play, sources say.
items.why: Sources indicate will play despite Q tags.
items.implication: Saints skill players available as normal.
items.opportunity: Standard usage locked; no major beneficiary shifts.

items.text: He’s back: The Bears are planning to start Caleb Williams after he missed the past three games due to a torn hamstring but went through a full week of practice this week without any setbacks.
items.why: Full practice week, no setbacks; confirmed active later.
items.implication: Bears offense returns to primary QB; boosts all pass-catchers.
items.opportunity: Normal dropback volume and designed runs for Williams; WR/TE upgrade.

items.text: With Huntley back under center expect another run heavy approach for BAL against CLE; all in on Andy Reid at home off a bye - Walker should be fresh & ready to rock... and there may be no hotter RB in the NFL these days than Jaylen Warren.
items.why: Run-heavy scripts, bye freshness for Walker, hot form for Warren.
items.implication: Strong start signals for both RBs in favorable spots.
items.opportunity: Elevated carries/red-zone in projected run games.

items.text: My guess - and it's a pure guess - is that it'll be a split between Cam & Najee. Everyone can run in the Saints so Harris has a better shot than DK vs TB at a TD today. I'd go Najee
items.why: Split expected; Saints run-friendly for TD equity vs tougher DK matchup.
items.implication: Najee viable flex/TD dart in PPR full.
items.opportunity: Goal-line/early down share potential in committee.

items.text: No news yet on status of DJ Moore, Josh Palmer, Tyjae Spears. Projections are updated for all news: https://establishtherun.com/draftkings-fanduel-yahoo-projections/
items.why: Incorporated AM injury summary and pending statuses into ETR projections hub.
items.implication: Use updated numbers for GTD resolutions and DFS/FF starts.

items.text: NOT EXPECTED TO PLAY * Deebo Samuel
items.implication: Commanders WR depth thinned; targets to others.
items.opportunity: Elevated role for remaining WAS pass-catchers.
